label: What is a series
subgoals: Accumulate s_n = a1+...+an term by term
Stack the partial sums into the sequence {s_n}
Write the series as a sum over k = 1 to infinity

label: Nature of a series
subgoals: Take lim s_n: finite means converge, infinite means diverge
Flag oscillation or missing limits as indeterminate

label: Necessary condition for convergence
subgoals: Split a_n = s_n - s_(n-1) into S - S = 0
Reject a_n not tending to 0 as divergent
